$comment: Evaluation task specs. Each entry is seeded as ONE issue PER AGENT by .github/workflows/eval-seed-issues.yml, so both agents receive identical work. Keep 'tasks' at 10 items or fewer: larger issues exceed an agent session budget and stall mid-way. Bump 'round' (or pass round= on dispatch) to seed a new round without duplicating the previous one.

specs.title: Booking confirmation emails
specs.why: Clients receive no confirmation after booking, so no-shows are high and owners field avoidable phone calls.
specs.scope: Transactional email on booking create/reschedule/cancel. Templating and a send adapter with a dev no-op driver.
specs.non_goals: Marketing email, SMS, and provider account setup are out of scope.
tasks: Add an email adapter interface with a dev/no-op driver selected by env
Create booking-confirmed, booking-rescheduled and booking-cancelled templates including tenant name, service, staff, start time and timezone
Send the confirmation on booking create within the existing tenant scope
Send the reschedule and cancellation emails on the corresponding transitions
Record each send attempt in AuditLog with outcome and template id
Add unit tests for template rendering across timezones
Add an integration test asserting a send is attempted exactly once per booking transition
acceptance: Creating a booking attempts exactly one confirmation send and writes one AuditLog row
Rescheduling and cancelling each send their own template and write their own AuditLog rows
Templates render the correct local time for at least two distinct tenant timezones
No email is sent when the dev/no-op driver is selected, but the attempt is still audited
All new tests pass and existing tests remain green
